## Statute
§152(a) - A dependent means a qualifying child or qualifying relative
§152(c)(1) - Defines qualifying child
§152(c)(2)(A) - Relationship: child of the taxpayer
## Reasoning
The statute at §152(a) defines a dependent as either a qualifying child or a qualifying relative. Section 152(c)(1) defines what a qualifying child is. The case facts state that Bob satisfies section 152(c)(1) for 2015, meaning Bob meets all requirements to be a qualifying child. Under §152(a), a qualifying child is a dependent. Since Bob satisfies the qualifying child requirements, Bob is a dependent of Alice under section 152(a).
## Answer
Answer: Entailment
